defuss-shadcn / Website / Industries / industry-ai

AI Startup

A one-page site for an AI startup with one product - an API that turns meeting recordings into decisions and action items: a replayed demo in the chat components, how it works, the API in curl, JavaScript and Python, benchmarks with how they were measured, pricing per 1M tokens with a cost calculator, plain claims about data handling, customers and a sign-up dialog. Three looks: Launch, Terminal and Research.

Open full screen

Quillon, meeting decisions API

The Look select switches palette, typefaces and how the notes in the margin are drawn: Launch (indigo, Space Grotesk, a marker hand, a neuro-noise Shader behind the hero), Terminal (phosphor green, JetBrains Mono, comments and brackets) and Research (paper and oxblood, Newsreader, margin notes and a figure caption). The demo replays an exchange in Session, Message, Bubble and Marker - Replay starts it again, under reduced motion it shows the whole exchange at once. The API is Tabs of Code Mockups with a copy button; the pricing has the monthly / yearly switch and a token calculator.

×%

Built from Site Header (its menu a Sheet on narrow screens), a Shader (neuro-noise) behind the hero, Session, Message, Bubble and Marker for the replayed demo, Process Steps, Tabs of Code Mockups, Stats, Pricing with a Slider calculator on a ticket (Shapes), Brand Logos, Testimonials and Dialogs for the sign-up, the imprint, the privacy notes and the status page. The palettes are tokens on the site's root, so every component inside follows the look.
